items.title: Amex GBT Chairman Bid for His Own Company — But Didn’t Revise the Offer
items.summary: Long Lake wasn’t the highest bidder for Amex GBT, but it was the fastest and most committed, which mattered more in a market rattled by AI uncertainty.

items.title: Why the Hotel Business Is Entering an Owner-First Era
items.summary: The asset-light model has been good for operators and their shareholders. The pressure it creates for the owners who carry the assets is only now being openly discussed — and the operators best placed to respond are the ones who have stood on both sides of that equation.

items.title: Saudi Tourism Chief Hamidaddin to Leave Role as Kingdom Rewrites Its Tourism Ambitions
items.summary: Saudi Arabia's tourism chief is out and the giga-projects are being scaled back. The Kingdom’s tourism mission may be "unchanged," but is being unmistakably revised.

items.title: Travel Industry Warns Against DHS Threat to Halt Customs at ‘Sanctuary Cities’
items.summary: Halting customs at Newark — one of the busiest international hubs in the U.S. — would be a logistical nightmare for airlines.

items.title: Luxury Retail’s Hospitality Problem Isn’t a Training Problem
items.summary: Saying luxury retail should be more hospitable ignores how most of the industry works.

items.title: Jamie Dimon Says Moats in Banking Are Temporary. Sounds Like Travel.
items.summary: In travel, as in banking, the moat you're defending today is probably shallower than you think. And it's likely someone is already digging around it.

items.title: What Iceland and Puerto Rico Reveal About Class Divide in Overtourism
items.summary: The global travel industry's framework for managing overtourism was built for rich countries. Ten years after Skift coined the term, that may be the underbelly it has revealed.

items.title: IndiGo Will Stick to Low-Cost DNA Even as Willie Walsh Takes Over
items.summary: While IndiGo Founder Rahul Bhatia said incoming CEO Willie Walsh will "run the shop in its entirety," but the strategic perimeter appears to have been drawn before Walsh has set foot in the building.
